alerts.disposition: The flagged regex only removes markup for a bounded offline text token/drift comparison of fixed official documentation. The derived text is never evaluated, inserted into HTML, sent as a URL or emitted into a browser; only hashes, bounded statuses and fixed issue reasons are saved. Therefore incomplete stripping cannot produce the reported script/HTML injection. This is deliberately not an HTML sanitizer or semantic HTML parser: token matches alone are not authoritative compatibility proof, and the contract requires separate semantic document and renderer/stdio review. Actual current official docs were checked in round13. No suppression or weakening of sanitization was applied.
